text.p: Jacksonville Savings Bank said on Friday its shareholders approved acquisition of Litchfield Community Savings S.B..
Under terms of the acquisition, Jacksonville will pay stockholders of LCS Bancorp Inc, Litchfield Community Savings' parent holding company, $17.75 for each of its shares.
At September 30, 1996, Jacksonville had assets of $143.7 million and LCS had assets of $18.4 million.
Following completion of the acquisition, Litchfield Community Savings will be merged into Jacksonville.
All full time employees of Litchfield Community Savings will be retained.
The acquisition is expected to be completed on or about January 2, 1997.

Jacksonville Savings Bank operates three offices in Jacksonville in Morgan County and an office in Virden in Macoupin County. Litchfield Community Savings is located in Montgomery County. Jacksonville is a subsidiary of Texas-based Jacksonville Bancorp Inc.
